scope: Homepage value-capture animation behind the existing tablet
concept: Illustrative exposure values descend, turn jade at interception, and move into the product view. This does not claim verified recovery.
implementation: Native SVG motion paths and capture pulses; no animation-frame JavaScript loop
Eight-second staggered cycles with no playback controls
Ambient layer behind the tablet with pointer events disabled and no document-flow changes
Responsive typography and fewer signals on phones
Animation pauses outside the viewport or when the tab is hidden
Reduced-motion preference hides falling amounts and pauses the SVG timeline
Decorative value field carries data-nosnippet to keep sample amounts out of search snippets

checks: Motion advances while the tablet is visible
Responsive amount type stays between 15 and 26 CSS pixels
Decorative content is hidden from assistive technology
Native tablet flip remains readable in both directions without changing page height
Tablet controls and the reduced-motion view switch remain usable
All six value paths reach their capture points within one SVG unit of the pulse timing
Full-cycle monetary-text collision sweep at 1101, 1280, 1366 and 1512px passes after a desktop gutter correction

claimGuardrails: Amounts are decorative exposure examples, not customer results
No accumulated total, verified-value label or automatic-recovery promise was added
